scope: 180 separate feed posts, not 180 days. 3 per week baseline => 60 weeks, last post Day418. First14days detailed after macro vision and full order.
vision_tr: Yiğit'in resimlerini tek bir karakter ya da tekniğe indirgemeden tanınan, yeniden bakılmak istenen ve eser gövdesi olarak incelenebilen bir pratiğe dönüştüren Instagram hesabı: tanıdık figürler, değişken bedenler, etkili mekânlar; geçmiş ve güncel işlerde gerçek resimsel kararlar.
promise_en: Familiar figures. Unstable bodies. Spaces that change the scene.

goals.G1: Keşif: ilgili yeni kişiyi esere getirmek
goals.G2: Tanınma: farklı eserlerde ressamın dilini ayırt ettirmek
goals.G3: Devam: yeniden bakma, kaydetme, ilgili takip ve eser sorusu
goals.G4: İnceleme: künyeli seçki/portföy ve gerçek mesleki veya eser talebi

phases.aim: Hesabın vaadini görünür kıl: üç sütun, güncel eser ve tarihli arşiv, gerçek üretim. İzleyici tek karakteri değil ressamı tanısın.
Bakışa derinlik kat: her eserde somut karar ve fark. İlk tanışıklığı gerekçeli yeniden bakmaya çevir.
Farklı girişlerden aynı pratiğe getir: kişisel mekân, sinema/müzik ve resimsel kaynaklar. Referans her zaman kendi resmine bağlansın.
Eser gövdesinin ilişkilerini göster: beden-mekân, karşılaşma-taşıma, format/ölçek; daha kapsamlı incelemeyi mümkün kıl.
Zaman içindeki süreklilik ve ayrımı aç: eskiyi gelişim basamağına indirgemeden 2019/2020/2023/2026 arasında somut farklar.
Biriken bakışı üç küçük seçkide topla ve yeni incelemeye aç: beden, sahne, mekân. Gerçek eser bilgilerinden portföy devamı. Kazanan/sonuç uydurma; veriye göre alternatif belirtilir.

per_post_schema.caption_en: one to three publishable factual EN sentences; credits appended centrally; don't invent intent
per_post_schema.idea_tr: exact creative execution, visible evidence and payoff
per_post_schema.why_tr: why this work for goal, no generic filler
per_post_schema.order_tr: concrete relationship with preceding/following post or phase: why HERE
per_post_schema.new_value_tr: what different information vs earlier reuse; name a feature, not just 'new angle'
per_post_schema.archive: boolean this is a meaningful historical artwork/study slot
per_post_schema.production_tr: exact known footage or still path IDs; mark required new filming/VO explicitly; no unfilmed action invented
per_post_schema.evidence: local catalogue/audit, artist account ID/time, research card Yxx
per_post_schema.check_tr: one specific falsifiable observation/metric appropriate to goal

rules: Human author every row; no cycling a work list to fill180. At least1 and at most2 meaningful archive posts per every3postweek. Vary position and format deliberately; no compulsory Reel quota.

No consecutive posts repeating same primary work. Do not reuse entire source for essentially same claim. Existing stills stay Single/Carousel, no slideshow Reel. Reel only authentic footage/story/dialogue or explicitly required new recorded presenter action. New production needs are allowed but clearly not already in archive.
All publishable text EN. Internal rationale Turkish. Avoid art jargon/general questions where concrete visual wording works.
Source catalogue is planning-180-posts/source-catalog.json; use work masters/details/process plus audited videos. No web/repo images, no InDesign. No AI reference mistaken for physical process.
Society A2763 is UNDated study; sketches A0001 A0004 A1696 A1718 A2763 A2795 have unknown dates; never stamp final artwork metadata onto study. Painstaking left-center-right A0028 A0029 A0027.
If post combines dated paintings with sketches, separate credit by object. Century/Penguin reference dates are exact catalogue values.

Gxd artist A1340 56-196sourcepath; Angora A1632 196-224home,308-364memory,616-644visit/threat,868-952colour; BoardA0620 28-84darkenpawns/leavebackground. No direct English quote invented; adapted newVO label.
Live footage Sept A1159..1172, Capricorn A2801/A2802, Board A0627..0631. Consult video notes before specific cuts. Aligned photo montage is not live process.
No autopost/ads/publication. No optimum frequency/hour or guaranteed growth claim. 5000organic goal at90days remains ambition/checkpoint not promise and not silently extended.
Do not represent chosen phase order as a compulsory viewer sequence: each post must answer its own promise. Long-term individual posts are substantive draft, revisable at checkpoints.
